title: [GMCP 203.035.01] Contract: Official MCP Registry discovery, validation, and publication
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-035-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: GMCP consumes the official Registry API and server.json format with pagination, filters, versions, package and remote endpoints, repository metadata, caching, mirrors and offline snapshots; validates entries before trust; and can lint and publish owned servers through authenticated workflows. Yank, deletion, namespace verification, malicious metadata, stale mirrors and registry outage behavior are deterministic and provenance-preserving. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
